scanNote:
12-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (86-bet).

Yuqorida chapda KO'K-YaShIL yorliqda oq '12' va 'Holidays with a Difference'.

CHAP USTUN:
16) 'Match the objects to their uses, then make sentences, as in the examples.' Qiya: 'open doors, show the time, open bottles, keep food cool, show the way, play music, clean teeth'. SURATLAR: bottle-opener (shisha ochgich), radio (yashil eski radio), compass (kompas), cooler (oq sovutgich quti, ichida ovqat), key (kalitlar), toothbrush (tish cho'tkasi), clock (devor soati). Ko'k qiya: 'A bottle-opener is something which opens bottles.'
17) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the following people talking about their holiday plans, and complete the notes in the table below. Then, use your notes to talk about what they are going to do, as in the example.'
   JADVAL (ko'k): NAME | WHERE TO GO | WEATHER | CLOTHES | THINGS TO DO.
   John | 1) ...... | freezing 2) ...... & lots of snow | lots of 3) ...... clothes | go 4) ......, skiing & fishing
   Sally | Jamaica | boiling 5) ...... | shorts, T-shirts & swimsuit | 6) ...... on the beach, go scuba diving & sailing
   Sue & Clive | Orkney Islands, Scotland | 7) ...... but changeable | clothes for all types of weather | visit historic sites, go to 8) ......, go hiking
   Ko'k qiya: 'John is going to Alaska. The weather will be freezing cold, so he's taking lots of warm clothes. He is planning to go climbing, skiing and fishing during his holiday.'
• To'q sariq 'Speaking': 'In pairs, ask and answer the questions below about your last holiday.' • Where did you go? Who did you go with? • How long did you stay there? • Where exactly did you stay? What were the facilities like? • What was the weather/food like? • What things did you do?

O'NG USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Communication: Making & Responding to Suggestions'.
18) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and fill in the missing words. Then, in pairs, act out dialogues using the prompts.'
   1 (SARIQ RAMKA): A: 1) .......... we do this weekend? B: 2) .......... we DRIVE UP TO THE MOUNTAINS? A: Hmm. I'm not really in the mood for that. Have you got any other ideas? B: 3) .......... GO SAILING. A: Yes. That's a great idea! • go dog-sledding, go skiing, go swimming, go to the seaside
   2 (YaShIL RAMKA): A: 1) .......... GO TO THE BEACH tomorrow? B: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm working. A: 2) .......... going on Sunday, then? B: Yes, that would be fine. • play football, go to the cinema, go for a picnic, go cycling, go out for a meal
• To'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
19) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya: 'hotel lobby, stretches, current prices, book early, is located, winter getaway, crystal-clear view, below freezing, starry sky, unforgettable experience, make new friends, outdoor activities, in the north of, keep warm, liven up'.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'.
20) Kasseta belgisi: 'Match the words which rhyme, then listen and check. Listen again and repeat.' Chap: sea (ko'k strelka → three), guest, gym, city, snow | him, three, pretty, go, west. O'ng: coast, heart, fun, yacht, hotel | start, hot, most, well, one.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '86'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the objects to their uses, then make sentences, as in the examples. open doors, show the time, open bottles, keep food cool, show the way, play music, clean teeth
exercises.instructionUz: Buyumlarni ularning vazifalariga moslang, keyin namunadagidek gaplar tuzing. open doors, show the time, open bottles, keep food cool, show the way, play music, clean teeth
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'A bottle-opener is something
   WHICH opens bottles.'

  ⚠ 'something WHICH + fe'l-S' -
  narsalar uchun 'which'.


BUYUMLAR:
  bottle-opener → open bottles
  radio → play music
  compass → show the way
  cooler → keep food cool
  key → open doors
  toothbrush → clean teeth
  clock → show the time


⚠ 'A COMPASS':

  = kompas. /ˈkʌmpəs/.


⚠ 'A COOLER':

  = sovutgich quti (piknik uchun).


⚠ 'A BOTTLE-OPENER':

  = shisha ochgich.
  ⚠ 'opener' = ochgich.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the following people talking about their holiday plans, and complete the notes in the table below. Then, use your notes to talk about what they are going to do, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi odamlarning ta'til rejalari haqida gapirishini tinglang va quyidagi jadvaldagi qaydlarni to'ldiring. Keyin qaydlaringizdan ular nima qilmoqchi ekani haqida gapirish uchun foydalaning, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK. 1-4 namunadan aniq;
5-8 ehtimoliy javoblar - audio
bilan tekshiring.


JADVAL:

  JOHN: Alaska; freezing COLD &
  lots of snow; lots of WARM
  clothes; go CLIMBING, skiing &
  fishing (namunadan)

  SALLY: Jamaica; boiling HOT;
  shorts, T-shirts & swimsuit;
  SUNBATHE on the beach, go scuba
  diving & sailing

  SUE & CLIVE: Orkney Islands,
  Scotland; MILD but changeable;
  clothes for all types of weather;
  visit historic sites, go to
  MUSEUMS, go hiking


⚠ 'CHANGEABLE':

  = o'zgaruvchan.
  ⚠ 'change' + 'able'.


⚠ 'MILD':

  = mo''tadil, yumshoq (ob-havo).


⚠ 'SCUBA DIVING':

  = akvalang bilan sho'ng'ish.


⚠ 'TO SUNBATHE':

  = quyoshda toblanmoq.


⚠ 'HISTORIC SITES':

  = tarixiy joylar.


⚠ 'HIKING':

  = piyoda sayohat (tog'da).


⚠ 'ORKNEY ISLANDS':

  = Orkney orollari (Shotlandiya
  shimolida).

exercises.instructionEn: Use your notes to talk about what they are going to do, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlaringizdan ular nima qilmoqchi ekani haqida gapirish uchun foydalaning, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP (namunadan):
  X is going to [joy]. The weather
  will be [ob-havo], so he/she's
  taking [kiyim]. He/She is planning
  to [ishlar] during the holiday.

  ⚠ 'is going to' = bormoqchi
  ⚠ 'is planning to' =
  rejalashtirmoqda
exercises.exampleEn: John is going to Alaska. The weather will be freezing cold, so he's taking lots of warm clothes. He is planning to go climbing, skiing and fishing during his holiday.
exercises.exampleUz: John Alyaskaga bormoqchi. Ob-havo muzday sovuq bo'ladi, shuning uchun u ko'p iliq kiyim olyapti. U ta'tilida alpinizm, chang'i va baliq ovlashni rejalashtirmoqda.
modelAnswers: Sally is going to Jamaica. The weather will be boiling hot, so she's taking shorts, T-shirts and a swimsuit. She is planning to sunbathe on the beach, go scuba diving and sailing during her holiday.

Sue and Clive are going to the Orkney Islands in Scotland. The weather will be mild but changeable, so they're taking clothes for all types of weather. They are planning to visit historic sites, go to museums and go hiking during their holiday.
modelAnswersUz: Sally Yamaykaga bormoqchi. Ob-havo qaynoq issiq bo'ladi, shuning uchun u shortik, futbolka va cho'milish kiyimi olyapti. U ta'tilida plyajda quyoshda toblanish, akvalang bilan sho'ng'ish va yelkanli qayiqda suzishni rejalashtirmoqda.

Sue va Clive Shotlandiyadagi Orkney orollariga bormoqchi. Ob-havo mo''tadil, lekin o'zgaruvchan bo'ladi, shuning uchun ular har xil ob-havo uchun kiyim olishyapti. Ular ta'tilida tarixiy joylarga borish, muzeylarga borish va piyoda sayohat qilishni rejalashtirmoqda.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer the questions below about your last holiday.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda oxirgi ta'tilingiz haqida quyidagi savollarga savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ O'TGAN ZAMON - 'last holiday'.

  Where did you GO? → I WENT to ...
  Who did you go WITH? → I went
    with ...
  How long did you STAY? → I
    stayed for ...
  Where exactly did you stay? →
    I stayed at/in ...
  What were the facilities LIKE?
    → They were ...
  What was the weather/food LIKE?
    → It was ...
  What things did you DO? → I ...


⚠ 'WHAT ... LIKE?':

  = qanday edi? (tavsif so'rash)
  ⚠ 'like' = yoqmoq EMAS!


⚠ 'EXACTLY':

  = aniq.


⚠ 'HOW LONG':

  = qancha vaqt.

items.question: What was the weather like? What was the food like?
items.answer: The weather was sunny and hot. The food was delicious.

items.answer: I visited historic sites, took lots of photos and went shopping at the bazaar.

sections.title: Communication: Making & Responding to Suggestions
sections.titleUz: Muloqot: Taklif qilish va takliflarga javob berish

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and fill in the missing words. Then, in pairs, act out dialogues using the prompts. • go dog-sledding, go skiing, go swimming, go to the seaside
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va tushirib qoldirilgan so'zlarni to'ldiring. Keyin juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib dialoglarni o'ynang. • go dog-sledding, go skiing, go swimming, go to the seaside
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio yo'q bo'lsa - taklif
qoliplaridan foydalaning.


TAKLIF QILISh QOLIPLARI:

  What shall we do ...?
    = Nima qilamiz?
  Shall we + fe'l?
    = ... qilaylikmi?
  Why don't we + fe'l?
    = Nega ... qilmaymiz?
  How about + -ING?
    = ... qilsak-chi?
  Let's + fe'l.
    = Kel, ... qilaylik.


JAVOB BERISh:

  ✓ That's a great idea!
  ✓ Yes, that would be fine.
  ✓ I'd love to.
  ✗ I'm not really in the mood for
    that. = Bunga kayfiyatim yo'q.
  ✗ I'd love to, but I can't.


JAVOBLAR (1-dialog):
  1 WHAT SHALL we do this weekend?
  2 SHALL WE / WHY DON'T WE drive
    up to the mountains?
  3 WHY DON'T WE / LET'S go
    sailing.


⚠ 'TO BE IN THE MOOD FOR':

  = ...ga kayfiyati bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'mood' = kayfiyat.


⚠ 'TO DRIVE UP TO':

  = mashinada bormoq (yuqoriga).

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR (2-dialog):
  1 WOULD YOU LIKE TO / SHALL WE go
    to the beach tomorrow?
  2 HOW ABOUT going on Sunday,
    then?

  ⚠ 'HOW ABOUT + -ING' - 'going'
  bor, demak 'How about'.


⚠ 'I'D LOVE TO, BUT I CAN'T':

  = Juda xohlardim, lekin qila
  olmayman. - muloyim rad etish.


⚠ 'THEN':

  gap oxirida = unda, bo'lmasa.


⚠ 'THAT WOULD BE FINE':

  = Bu yaxshi bo'lardi.
